title: PeerRateLimiter (rate_limit.rs) is dead code — parallel connections bypass rate limit
description: transit/src/peering/rate_limit.rs contains a PeerRateLimiter struct that tracks per-IP rate limits across all connections from the same peer. It is never instantiated anywhere in the codebase. session.rs instead uses a private per-connection TokenBucket (lines 214-244, created fresh at line 59 for every TCP connection). A peer can open N simultaneous connections and get N * 200-article burst (and N * 100 articles/sec sustained) from the per-connection limiters, bypassing the intent of the global per-IP limiter entirely. With 10 connections a peer can inject 2000 articles in a burst. Fix: instantiate PeerRateLimiter in the shared peering state (PeeringShared), call it from session.rs in place of the local TokenBucket.
